body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Venice, Italy. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 1 km. It starts at La Fenice, Campo San Fantin, 1965. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to La Fenice Theatre + official audio tour. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the enchanting La Fenice Theatre in Venice with this self-guided audio tour! Whether you're a lover of opera or simply want to immerse yourself in the beauty and history of one of Italy's most celebrated theaters, this official tour is sure to leave you captivated and inspired.
>
> Experience the magic of one of the most renowned opera houses in the world at your own pace, with an expertly crafted commentary that takes you on a journey through the history and artistry of this iconic venue.
>
> With this easy-to-use audio guide, you'll explore the stunning architecture and ornate interiors of La Fenice, learning about its rich history and the incredible performances that have taken place within its walls. You'll discover fascinating stories about the theatre's founding, its tumultuous past, and its triumphant rebirth after devastating fires.
>
> This tour also offers a unique behind-the-scenes look at La Fenice, taking you to areas typically overlooked by the public, such as the Royal Box and the Apollo Rooms. You'll spot some magnificent details of the Baroque interiors and learn about historical events witnessed by the theatre.
>
> WeGoTrip is an authorized reseller of Venezia Unica services.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.88. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 295 ratings and 151 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
